newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CNPC says in HK$217 mln share issue.
newsitem.headline: CNPC says in HK$217 mln share issue.

text.p: CNPC (Hong Kong) Ltd said on Tuesday it had agreed to issue 297 million new shares to its controlling shareholder Sun World Ltd at HK$0.7319 per share, raising about HK$217 million.

The oil explorer said in a statement that Sun World would subscribe to the new shares after placing 297 million existing shares, or 6.91 percent of CNPC's existing issued share capital, at HK$0.75 a share with professional and institutional investors.
CNPC shares fell HK$0.01 to close at HK$0.79 on Monday

The company said it planned to use about HK$100 million of the proceeds to partly fund obligations under an infill development programme being undertaken near Karamay City in Xinjiang Province, China, and the remainder for general working capital.
After the transactions, Sun World would own 54.23 percent of CNPC's enlarged issued share capital compared with a current 57.98 percent, CNPC said.
